highlights.title: Chat boxes a little taller on a phone
highlights.line: The message and search boxes in an agent's chat and a project room are a little taller on a phone, so they are easier to tap.

highlights.title: When your Mac is not answering
highlights.line: Through Kosmos Plus, an open board says your Mac is not answering, that it may be asleep or turned off, and what to do.

highlights.title: Your phone says when it is offline
highlights.line: Through Kosmos Plus, a phone or computer with no internet is told it is offline, not that Kosmos is not answering.

highlights.title: Undo an org chart upload
highlights.line: After Create the team makes agents, Undo lists what it will remove, then removes only the agents it made.

highlights.title: Tasks easier to use on a phone
highlights.line: Tapping a field no longer makes the screen zoom in, and every button and link on the Tasks page is easy to tap.
